name: Sanctuary Lights and Gremlin Hands
summary:
AN UNUSUAL WINTER STORM STRIKES AN UNPREPARED FAIRBROOKS — roads buried, power cut, much of the city without reliable heat or light. The Found Family answers by turning its trades outward. EVIE BECOMES THE ELECTRICAL HEART OF THE RESPONSE — already certified, finally visible; Harley works as a medic in the dark; and the rest build a web of warmth, shelter, transport, repairs, food and community care. The city learns what SANCTUARY DRIVE means beyond an address.

AND BRYN ADOPTS EXACTLY TWO WOMEN IN THE WHOLE ARC: LUMINA AND ABBI. Her quietest arc for intake, one of the loudest to live through.
events: THE STORM AND THE BLACKOUT — neighbourhoods isolated, infrastructure failing under weather the city was never built for

EVIE'S CERTIFICATION STOPS BEING A LINE ON A PROFILE AND BECOMES A CROWBAR. She is the woman who puts the lights back on — the Lucky Hammer, the apartment, Livi's gym, Roseforge Smithy, AND MARIANNE'S CLINIC. Priorities
THE LUCKY HAMMER OPENS ITS DOORS A MONTH EARLY to help, once Evie has the power on
HARLEY WORKS AS A MEDIC IN THE DARK — field treatment and emergency care without dependable light or ideal equipment

ADOPTED: LUMINA AND ABBI, and nobody else all arc. Abbi arrives ALREADY the fully realised little forge gremlin Lumina knows and loves — this arc is about the pair becoming family, not about inventing who they are

ABBI'S HANDS GET THEIR THEMATIC WEIGHT. The hands Jonah taught her to fear spend an entire winter forging, repairing, carrying and sheltering people, while Lumina teaches her that USEFULNESS IS NOT THE PRICE OF BEING ALLOWED TO STAY

THE FAMILY'S JOBS STOP BEING FLAVOUR TEXT. Mechanics keep vehicles and generators alive, builders make damaged places safe, medical hands tend the injured, cooks feed the stranded, organisers match needs to supplies — women who survived by depending on each other showing a city how the network works
HARLEY ASKS YVAINE THE QUESTION during this arc, and then sits on it until their marriage in ARC 11
PANDORA FINDS THAT HAVING A BODY IS BETTER THAN NOT — and Jade learns she can CORRECT Pandora's gropy hands BY SWATTING HER TITS
AKANE'S TEA SHOP OPENS around this arc
CAMEO: GWEN BEGINS HER SIDE QUEST FARMING FOR AKANE'S APPROVAL — and her heart. Akane is a strange one; she sent her prospective suitor on SIDE QUESTS. The fuller farming arc is an Arc 8 matter
CAMEO: CYRENA AND DESTINY APPEAR IN THE LUCKY HAMMER. Fucking. Sera sighs and shakes her head. BRYN SAYS NOT YET
BIRTHDAYS: Sera, Livi, Alice and Nova — domestic rhythm between storm beats, so the arc is not trapped in continuous disaster mode
SUB-ARC: Evie's certification and the Lucky Hammer thread — the principal under-arc, occupying the place Roseforge held beneath Arc 6

SUB-ARC: Lumina and Abbi's integration — gremlin behaviour on the surface, and underneath it the old fear that her strength only breaks things. The storm keeps handing her evidence otherwise. THE FAMILY IS CHOOSING BOTH OF THEM
NOTE: Arcs 7 and 8 are being rewritten, because Pandora wanted to be with Jade earlier than Arc 8
